Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Brief Introduction To The Team**
 Expedia Global Payments (EGP) is hiring engineers to build and evolve the core platform of our globally distributed payment system. We process over $100B annually in more than 35 currencies. Our priorities are high availability, lower payment\-processing costs, and better experiences for travelers and partners (hotels, airlines, and more).
   

  

 You will help build the payment experience within our Unified Payment Module, which supports complex payment scenarios. Our goal is to give travelers the simplest, most reliable way to pay and to make these capabilities easy for partners to adopt—seamlessly integrating into any checkout with an adaptive, dynamic feature set.
   

  

 Today, the unified Payment Module powers our Modern Checkout, EGP Advertising, EGP Private label solution. It:
   

  

* Manages multiple forms of payment—Credit cards, Affirm, Apple Pay, Naver Pay, PayPal, Google Pay, loaclised payments, gift cards, and loyalty programs.
* Determines which payment options are eligible for each checkout context.


 We are expanding the payment experience to support additional lines of business—Air, Cars, Cruises, Activities—and more points of sale worldwide within unified payment module.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build and maintain backend services and platform capabilities within Expedia Group’s Payments domain using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and AWS.
* Design and implement reliable service\-to\-service communication and distributed\-system capabilities, including gRPC integrations and NoSQL data solutions.
* Apply computer science fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to deliver scalable backend solutions.
* Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to clarify requirements, evaluate trade\-offs, resolve ambiguous technical problems, and deliver practical outcomes.
* Take ownership of backend services and contribute across technical domains, including adapting to Kotlin\-based development environments as needed.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including applying AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows to enhance engineering productivity and delivery.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience building backend services with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, AWS, distributed systems, and service\-to\-service communication.
* Proficiency in coding, data structures and algorithms, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling, with experience owning backend services or capabilities.
* Knowledge of NoSQL databases, preferably DynamoDB, along with clear communication and collaborative problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing backend systems in a product\-focused technology organization, with demonstrated ownership of services operating at meaningful scale.
* Experience with Kotlin or the ability to work effectively across Java\- and Kotlin\-based backend environments.
* Strong practical experience with gRPC, distributed\-system design, DynamoDB, and scalable microservice architectures.
* Demonstrated operational excellence through reliable delivery, thoughtful trade\-off analysis, and data\-informed improvements to backend services.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows to accelerate software engineering, improve delivery outcomes, or enhance backend products.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Payoneer**



Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.



By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.


Principal Engineer – Backend


**About Payoneer**



Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross\-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.


**The Opportunity**



We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.



This is a high\-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.



As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.



The role also requires an AI\-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).


**What You'll Do**


* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large\-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.


* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.


* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.


* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.


* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.


* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.


* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.


* Champion an AI\-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.


* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent\-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.


* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross\-domain problems.


* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.


* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.


* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.


* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.


* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross\-functional teams.


* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.


**What We're Looking For**


* Extensive experience designing and building large\-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.


* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data\-intensive systems, and cloud\-native architectures.


* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event\-driven architectures, and scalability.


* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.


* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.


* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.


* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.


* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI\-first engineering systems and workflows.


* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.


* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.


* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.


* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.


* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross\-functional engineering environment.


**What Success Looks Like**



In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.



You will:


* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.


* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.


* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.


* Help Payoneer adopt an AI\-first engineering culture and identify high\-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.


* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.


* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.


* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.


**Why This Role**



The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.



You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI\-first world.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**


**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  

*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*


**Do it. Own it.**
  

*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*


**Continuously improve**
  

*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*


**Build each other up**  

*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*



If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.


*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case\-by\-case basis.*
